capturedFrom.method: read-only extraction of the shipped app.asar; no network, no credentials, no model calls

notes: routes deepseek-official and deepseek-account share the same wire transport but bill differently (API key versus account grant); they are different billing channels, not different vendors.
model ids pass through to the wire: an id absent from the default catalog is still dispatched as a text-only route, so absence here is 'unverified id', not 'impossible'.
list prices are USD per million tokens converted to micro-minor units (1 USD = 100 cents = 100000000 micro-minor). They are catalog values, not invoices.
a second vendor provider is only available when its adapter is configured; this catalog does not prove any non-DeepSeek provider is configured or reachable.
